narrative.text:
I’ll read the host/framework contracts and supplied test lists, then write the design doc and fixture spec. I won’t change production code.The narrowed B contract is channel-only: route failures keep admitted work private with a notice; they don’t refuse admission. It also has no initialize-offer or thread-target API.

I’ll recommend migrating F-Slack first and adding no legacy host adapter, rather than promising v1 behavior these APIs can’t provide. The doc will make that ordering a release prerequisite.Verified the policy-shape SHA-256: `3574d8885580636a4269cadeb82bfb116695bccc62434209b62d853ecaa02911`. I’ll use those placeholders only for config examples and tests, not as observed grants.

I’ve taken the AF 0.31 requirement into account: the design will require one integration commit and a reproducible, integrity-pinned fork tarball. Host `^0.30.0` does not cover AF 0.31.The draft now covers the added loss gate: pending work is separate from committed dedup, and only a known pre-storage refusal permits fresh re-admission. An uncertain ACK is quarantined, not retried.

It also records the confirmed reconnect rule: never re-resolve; stale authority keeps prose private with B’s internal agent notice. I’ll check the documentation scope and links, then commit locally.
